en.text: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. From omega of I equals 1, the program follows preserved identity.

translations.en: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. From omega of I equals 1, the program follows preserved identity.
translations.fr: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. À partir d’oméga de I égal à 1, le programme suit l’identité préservée.
translations.pt-BR: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. A partir de ômega de I igual a 1, o programa acompanha a identidade preservada.
translations.zh-Hans: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica。从 ω(I) 等于 1 出发，程序追踪保持的恒等性。

en.text: ONTO: illustrative geometry. INPUT: the cosmic setting. Now the boundary takes shape.

translations.en: ONTO: illustrative geometry. INPUT: the cosmic setting. Now the boundary takes shape.
translations.fr: ONTO : géométrie illustrative. INPUT : décor cosmique de présentation. La frontière prend maintenant forme.
translations.pt-BR: ONTO: geometria ilustrativa. INPUT: ambiente cósmico de apresentação. Agora a fronteira toma forma.
translations.zh-Hans: ONTO：示意几何。INPUT：宇宙展示背景。现在边界开始成形。

en.text: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.

translations.en: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.
translations.fr: L’autoconjugaison fait de la frontière son propre complément. Son point fixe vaut 0,5.
translations.pt-BR: A autoconjugação torna a fronteira seu próprio complemento. Seu ponto fixo é 0,5.
translations.zh-Hans: 自共轭使边界成为自身的补集。不动点为 0.5。

en.text: In this derivation, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. The associated volume is the square root of e.

translations.en: In this derivation, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. The associated volume is the square root of e.
translations.fr: Dans cette dérivation, l’entropie de frontière vaut 0,5 nat. Le volume associé est la racine carrée de e.
translations.pt-BR: Nesta derivação, a entropia da fronteira é 0,5 nat. O volume associado é a raiz quadrada de e.
translations.zh-Hans: 在此推导中，边界熵为 0.5 纳特，相关体积为 e 的平方根。

en.text: Alpha times the square root of e gives beta: 0.012. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.

translations.en: Alpha times the square root of e gives beta: 0.012. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.
translations.fr: Alpha fois la racine carrée de e donne bêta : 0,012. L’angle de projection vaut 6,3 degrés.
translations.pt-BR: Alfa vezes a raiz quadrada de e dá beta: 0,012. O ângulo da projeção é 6,3 graus.
translations.zh-Hans: α 乘以 e 的平方根得到 β：0.012。投影角为 6.3 度。

en.text: Reflection carries beta; transmission its complement. The S matrix preserves their sum; the angle reads the face.

translations.en: Reflection carries beta; transmission its complement. The S matrix preserves their sum; the angle reads the face.
translations.fr: La réflexion porte bêta ; la transmission, son complément. La matrice S conserve leur somme ; l’angle lit la face.
translations.pt-BR: A reflexão leva beta; a transmissão, seu complemento. A matriz S preserva a soma; o ângulo lê a face.
translations.zh-Hans: 反射承载 β，透射承载其补量。S 矩阵保持两者之和；角度是对面的读取。

en.text: J composed with J preserves identity; conjugation by J reverses K. The crossing ray follows this reversal.

translations.en: J composed with J preserves identity; conjugation by J reverses K. The crossing ray follows this reversal.
translations.fr: J composé avec J préserve l’identité ; la conjugaison par J inverse K. Le rayon traversant suit cette inversion.
translations.pt-BR: J composto com J preserva a identidade; a conjugação por J inverte K. O raio que atravessa acompanha essa inversão.
translations.zh-Hans: J 与自身复合保持恒等；以 J 共轭使 K 反号。穿越的光线跟随这一反转。

en.text: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.

translations.en: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.
translations.fr: Le retour ambré rend visible la part réfléchie : un retour parmi 83 rayons. La part restante traverse le miroir.
translations.pt-BR: O retorno âmbar torna visível a parcela refletida: um retorno entre 83 raios. A parcela restante atravessa o espelho.
translations.zh-Hans: 琥珀色返回显现反射份额：每 83 条光线中一次返回。其余份额穿过镜面。

en.text: The hyperbolic modular flow acts on the faces. The Powers ladder carries beta between scales, while Breuer’s gap supports the finite trace.

translations.en: The hyperbolic modular flow acts on the faces. The Powers ladder carries beta between scales, while Breuer’s gap supports the finite trace.
translations.fr: Le flot modulaire hyperbolique agit sur les faces. L’échelle de Powers transporte bêta entre échelles, tandis que le gap de Breuer soutient la trace finie.
translations.pt-BR: O fluxo modular hiperbólico atua nas faces. A cadeia de Powers transporta beta entre escalas, enquanto o gap de Breuer sustenta o traço finito.
translations.zh-Hans: 双曲模流作用于面。Powers 阶梯在尺度之间传递 β，而 Breuer 能隙支持有限迹。

en.text: The coframe organizes this structure into local directions. As the faces become a sheet, those directions connect the modular construction to the Lorentz geometry.

translations.en: The coframe organizes this structure into local directions. As the faces become a sheet, those directions connect the modular construction to the Lorentz geometry.
translations.fr: Le corepère organise cette structure en directions locales. Quand les faces deviennent une nappe, ces directions relient la construction modulaire à la géométrie de Lorentz.
translations.pt-BR: O coframe organiza essa estrutura em direções locais. Quando as faces se tornam lençol, essas direções ligam a construção modular à geometria de Lorentz.
translations.zh-Hans: 余标架将这一结构组织为局部方向。当面成为薄片，这些方向把模构造连接到洛伦兹几何。

en.text: Soldering connects the frame to geometry. Applying the Lorentz generators in opposite orders leaves the rotation displayed by their commutator.

translations.en: Soldering connects the frame to geometry. Applying the Lorentz generators in opposite orders leaves the rotation displayed by their commutator.
translations.fr: La soudure relie le repère à la géométrie. Appliquer les générateurs de Lorentz dans des ordres opposés laisse la rotation affichée par leur commutateur.
translations.pt-BR: A solda conecta o referencial à geometria. Aplicar os geradores de Lorentz em ordens opostas deixa a rotação exibida pelo comutador.
translations.zh-Hans: 焊接把标架连接到几何。以相反顺序应用洛伦兹生成元，留下其对易子所示的旋转。

en.text: The plaquette follows transport around a small loop. Its mismatch makes curvature visible; the displayed curvature formula ties that change to the generator coefficients.

translations.en: The plaquette follows transport around a small loop. Its mismatch makes curvature visible; the displayed curvature formula ties that change to the generator coefficients.
translations.fr: La plaquette suit le transport sur une petite boucle. Son écart rend visible la courbure ; la formule affichée relie ce changement aux coefficients des générateurs.
translations.pt-BR: A plaqueta acompanha o transporte num pequeno circuito. Seu desajuste torna visível a curvatura; a fórmula exibida liga essa mudança aos coeficientes dos geradores.
translations.zh-Hans: 小回路跟随输运绕行。回返的差异使曲率显现；所示曲率公式将这一变化与生成元系数联系起来。

en.text: The sheet descends into the throat as the camera follows the static, spherical Schwarzschild geometry. The optical construction shapes the path through the scene.

translations.en: The sheet descends into the throat as the camera follows the static, spherical Schwarzschild geometry. The optical construction shapes the path through the scene.
translations.fr: La nappe descend dans la gorge tandis que la caméra suit la géométrie statique et sphérique de Schwarzschild. La construction optique façonne le parcours dans la scène.
translations.pt-BR: O lençol desce à garganta enquanto a câmera acompanha a geometria estática e esférica de Schwarzschild. A construção óptica dá forma ao percurso na cena.
translations.zh-Hans: 薄片向喉部下沉，镜头跟随史瓦西静态球对称几何。光学构造塑造场景中的路径。

en.text: Beside it, the temporal and radial residuals compare the calculated geometry with the equations. Their displayed values let the viewer follow that check as the horizon comes into view.

translations.en: Beside it, the temporal and radial residuals compare the calculated geometry with the equations. Their displayed values let the viewer follow that check as the horizon comes into view.
translations.fr: À côté, les résidus temporel et radial comparent la géométrie calculée aux équations. Leurs valeurs affichées permettent de suivre cette vérification lorsque l’horizon apparaît.
translations.pt-BR: Ao lado, os resíduos temporal e radial comparam a geometria calculada com as equações. Seus valores exibidos permitem acompanhar essa verificação quando o horizonte aparece.
translations.zh-Hans: 旁边的时间和径向残差将计算几何与方程比较。视界显现时，观众可通过所示数值跟随这项检验。

en.text: The tensor rotates with the spin weight shown by the program. Opposite helicities provide 2 transverse polarizations.

translations.en: The tensor rotates with the spin weight shown by the program. Opposite helicities provide 2 transverse polarizations.
translations.fr: Le tenseur tourne avec le poids de spin indiqué par le programme. Les hélicités opposées fournissent 2 polarisations transverses.
translations.pt-BR: O tensor gira com o peso de spin mostrado pelo programa. Helicidades opostas fornecem 2 polarizações transversais.
translations.zh-Hans: 张量按程序显示的自旋权重旋转。相反螺旋度提供 2 个横向偏振。

en.text: As the frame turns, the helix tracks the tensor’s angular phase. Its paired strands make the polarization structure visible while the displayed residual checks the transformation law.

translations.en: As the frame turns, the helix tracks the tensor’s angular phase. Its paired strands make the polarization structure visible while the displayed residual checks the transformation law.
translations.fr: Quand le repère tourne, l’hélice suit la phase angulaire du tenseur. Ses brins rendent visible la structure de polarisation, tandis que le résidu affiché vérifie la loi de transformation.
translations.pt-BR: Quando o referencial gira, a hélice acompanha a fase angular do tensor. Seus ramos tornam visível a estrutura de polarização, enquanto o resíduo exibido verifica a lei de transformação.
translations.zh-Hans: 标架旋转时，螺旋跟随张量的角相位。其成对分支显现偏振结构，同时所示残差检验变换规律。

en.text: H₁ supplies trace and gap; H₂, coframe and Lorentz; H₃, horizon and Clausius. These assemble the Pentad.

translations.en: H₁ supplies trace and gap; H₂, coframe and Lorentz; H₃, horizon and Clausius. These assemble the Pentad.
translations.fr: H₁ fournit trace et gap ; H₂, corepère et Lorentz ; H₃, horizon et Clausius. Ainsi s’assemble la Pentade.
translations.pt-BR: H₁ fornece traço e gap; H₂, coframe e Lorentz; H₃, horizonte e Clausius. Assim se compõe a Pêntada.
translations.zh-Hans: H₁ 提供迹和能隙；H₂ 提供余标架与洛伦兹结构；H₃ 提供视界与克劳修斯关系。它们组合成五元组。

en.text: Clausius links heat, surface gravity and area, yielding Einstein’s coefficient. The kernel ladder has 9561 theorems; the gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.

translations.en: Clausius links heat, surface gravity and area, yielding Einstein’s coefficient. The kernel ladder has 9561 theorems; the gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.
translations.fr: Clausius relie chaleur, gravité de surface et aire, donnant le coefficient d’Einstein. L’échelle du noyau compte 9561 théorèmes ; la porte, 15 indicateurs calculés et 3 littéraux.
translations.pt-BR: Clausius liga calor, gravidade superficial e área, dando o coeficiente de Einstein. A escada do kernel tem 9561 teoremas; o gate, 15 bandeiras calculadas e 3 literais.
translations.zh-Hans: 克劳修斯关系连接热量、表面引力与面积，给出爱因斯坦系数。内核阶梯有 9561 个定理；门控有 15 个计算标志和 3 个字面标志。

en.text: Identity returns with residual 0. Together: calibrated z 4.44, one-sided p 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result stays below it.

translations.en: Identity returns with residual 0. Together: calibrated z 4.44, one-sided p 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result stays below it.
translations.fr: L’identité revient avec un résidu de 0. Ensemble : z calibré 4,44, p unilatéral 0,00000443, seuil 5 sigma. Le résultat reste en dessous.
translations.pt-BR: A identidade retorna com resíduo 0. Juntos: z calibrado 4,44, p unilateral 0,00000443, limiar 5 sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo dele.
translations.zh-Hans: 恒等返回的残差为 0。共同显示：校准 z 为 4.44，单侧 p 为 0.00000443，阈值为 5 sigma。结果仍低于该阈值。

en.text: z delta -1.48: not falsified with power. Log Bayes is not sigma. Proved in the kernel under its hypotheses; nature decides.

translations.en: z delta -1.48: not falsified with power. Log Bayes is not sigma. Proved in the kernel under its hypotheses; nature decides.
translations.fr: z delta -1,48 : non falsifiée avec puissance. Log Bayes n’est pas sigma. Prouvé dans le noyau sous ses hypothèses ; la nature tranche.
translations.pt-BR: z delta -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Log Bayes não é sigma. Provado no kernel sob suas hipóteses; a natureza decide.
translations.zh-Hans: z delta 为 -1.48：在有检验功效的条件下未被证伪。对数贝叶斯因子不是 sigma。在假设之下于内核中证明；自然裁决。

translations.en: As the frame turns, the helix tracks the tensor’s angular phase. Its paired strands make the polarization structure visible while the displayed residual checks the transformation law.
translations.fr: Quand le repère tourne, l’hélice suit la phase angulaire du tenseur. Ses brins rendent visible la structure de polarisation, tandis que le résidu affiché vérifie la loi de transformation.
translations.pt-BR: Quando o referencial gira, a hélice acompanha a fase angular do tensor. Seus ramos tornam visível a estrutura de polarização, enquanto o resíduo exibido verifica a lei de transformação.
translations.zh-Hans: 标架旋转时，螺旋跟随张量的角相位。其成对分支显现偏振结构，同时所示残差检验变换规律。

pt-BR.text: H₁ fornece traço e gap; H₂, coframe e Lorentz; H₃, horizonte e Clausius. Assim se compõe a Pêntada.

translations.en: H₁ supplies trace and gap; H₂, coframe and Lorentz; H₃, horizon and Clausius. These assemble the Pentad.
translations.fr: H₁ fournit trace et gap ; H₂, corepère et Lorentz ; H₃, horizon et Clausius. Ainsi s’assemble la Pentade.
translations.pt-BR: H₁ fornece traço e gap; H₂, coframe e Lorentz; H₃, horizonte e Clausius. Assim se compõe a Pêntada.
translations.zh-Hans: H₁ 提供迹和能隙；H₂ 提供余标架与洛伦兹结构；H₃ 提供视界与克劳修斯关系。它们组合成五元组。

pt-BR.text: Clausius liga calor, gravidade superficial e área, dando o coeficiente de Einstein. A escada do kernel tem 9561 teoremas; o gate, 15 bandeiras calculadas e 3 literais.

translations.en: Clausius links heat, surface gravity and area, yielding Einstein’s coefficient. The kernel ladder has 9561 theorems; the gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.
translations.fr: Clausius relie chaleur, gravité de surface et aire, donnant le coefficient d’Einstein. L’échelle du noyau compte 9561 théorèmes ; la porte, 15 indicateurs calculés et 3 littéraux.
translations.pt-BR: Clausius liga calor, gravidade superficial e área, dando o coeficiente de Einstein. A escada do kernel tem 9561 teoremas; o gate, 15 bandeiras calculadas e 3 literais.
translations.zh-Hans: 克劳修斯关系连接热量、表面引力与面积，给出爱因斯坦系数。内核阶梯有 9561 个定理；门控有 15 个计算标志和 3 个字面标志。

pt-BR.text: A identidade retorna com resíduo 0. Juntos: z calibrado 4,44, p unilateral 0,00000443, limiar 5 sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo dele.

translations.en: Identity returns with residual 0. Together: calibrated z 4.44, one-sided p 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result stays below it.
translations.fr: L’identité revient avec un résidu de 0. Ensemble : z calibré 4,44, p unilatéral 0,00000443, seuil 5 sigma. Le résultat reste en dessous.
translations.pt-BR: A identidade retorna com resíduo 0. Juntos: z calibrado 4,44, p unilateral 0,00000443, limiar 5 sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo dele.
translations.zh-Hans: 恒等返回的残差为 0。共同显示：校准 z 为 4.44，单侧 p 为 0.00000443，阈值为 5 sigma。结果仍低于该阈值。

pt-BR.text: z delta -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Log Bayes não é sigma. Provado no kernel sob suas hipóteses; a natureza decide.

translations.en: z delta -1.48: not falsified with power. Log Bayes is not sigma. Proved in the kernel under its hypotheses; nature decides.
translations.fr: z delta -1,48 : non falsifiée avec puissance. Log Bayes n’est pas sigma. Prouvé dans le noyau sous ses hypothèses ; la nature tranche.
translations.pt-BR: z delta -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Log Bayes não é sigma. Provado no kernel sob suas hipóteses; a natureza decide.
translations.zh-Hans: z delta 为 -1.48：在有检验功效的条件下未被证伪。对数贝叶斯因子不是 sigma。在假设之下于内核中证明；自然裁决。

cues.en: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. From omega of I equals 1, the program follows preserved identity.
cues.fr: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. À partir d’oméga de I égal à 1, le programme suit l’identité préservée.
cues.pt-BR: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. A partir de ômega de I igual a 1, o programa acompanha a identidade preservada.
cues.zh-Hans: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica。从 ω(I) 等于 1 出发，程序追踪保持的恒等性。

cues.en: ONTO: illustrative geometry. INPUT: the cosmic setting. Now the boundary takes shape.
cues.fr: ONTO : géométrie illustrative. INPUT : décor cosmique de présentation. La frontière prend maintenant forme.
cues.pt-BR: ONTO: geometria ilustrativa. INPUT: ambiente cósmico de apresentação. Agora a fronteira toma forma.
cues.zh-Hans: ONTO：示意几何。INPUT：宇宙展示背景。现在边界开始成形。

cues.en: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.
cues.fr: L’autoconjugaison fait de la frontière son propre complément. Son point fixe vaut 0,5.
cues.pt-BR: A autoconjugação torna a fronteira seu próprio complemento. Seu ponto fixo é 0,5.
cues.zh-Hans: 自共轭使边界成为自身的补集。不动点为 0.5。

cues.en: In this derivation, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. The associated volume is the square root of e.
cues.fr: Dans cette dérivation, l’entropie de frontière vaut 0,5 nat. Le volume associé est la racine carrée de e.
cues.pt-BR: Nesta derivação, a entropia da fronteira é 0,5 nat. O volume associado é a raiz quadrada de e.
cues.zh-Hans: 在此推导中，边界熵为 0.5 纳特，相关体积为 e 的平方根。

cues.en: Alpha times the square root of e gives beta: 0.012. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.
cues.fr: Alpha fois la racine carrée de e donne bêta : 0,012. L’angle de projection vaut 6,3 degrés.
cues.pt-BR: Alfa vezes a raiz quadrada de e dá beta: 0,012. O ângulo da projeção é 6,3 graus.
cues.zh-Hans: α 乘以 e 的平方根得到 β：0.012。投影角为 6.3 度。

cues.en: Reflection carries beta; transmission its complement. The S matrix preserves their sum; the angle reads the face.
cues.fr: La réflexion porte bêta ; la transmission, son complément. La matrice S conserve leur somme ; l’angle lit la face.
cues.pt-BR: A reflexão leva beta; a transmissão, seu complemento. A matriz S preserva a soma; o ângulo lê a face.
cues.zh-Hans: 反射承载 β，透射承载其补量。S 矩阵保持两者之和；角度是对面的读取。

cues.en: J composed with J preserves identity; conjugation by J reverses K. The crossing ray follows this reversal.
cues.fr: J composé avec J préserve l’identité ; la conjugaison par J inverse K. Le rayon traversant suit cette inversion.
cues.pt-BR: J composto com J preserva a identidade; a conjugação por J inverte K. O raio que atravessa acompanha essa inversão.
cues.zh-Hans: J 与自身复合保持恒等；以 J 共轭使 K 反号。穿越的光线跟随这一反转。

cues.en: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.
cues.fr: Le retour ambré rend visible la part réfléchie : un retour parmi 83 rayons. La part restante traverse le miroir.
cues.pt-BR: O retorno âmbar torna visível a parcela refletida: um retorno entre 83 raios. A parcela restante atravessa o espelho.
cues.zh-Hans: 琥珀色返回显现反射份额：每 83 条光线中一次返回。其余份额穿过镜面。

cues.en: The hyperbolic modular flow acts on the faces. The Powers ladder carries beta between scales, while Breuer’s gap supports the finite trace.
cues.fr: Le flot modulaire hyperbolique agit sur les faces. L’échelle de Powers transporte bêta entre échelles, tandis que le gap de Breuer soutient la trace finie.
cues.pt-BR: O fluxo modular hiperbólico atua nas faces. A cadeia de Powers transporta beta entre escalas, enquanto o gap de Breuer sustenta o traço finito.
cues.zh-Hans: 双曲模流作用于面。Powers 阶梯在尺度之间传递 β，而 Breuer 能隙支持有限迹。

cues.en: The coframe organizes this structure into local directions. As the faces become a sheet, those directions connect the modular construction to the Lorentz geometry.
cues.fr: Le corepère organise cette structure en directions locales. Quand les faces deviennent une nappe, ces directions relient la construction modulaire à la géométrie de Lorentz.
cues.pt-BR: O coframe organiza essa estrutura em direções locais. Quando as faces se tornam lençol, essas direções ligam a construção modular à geometria de Lorentz.
cues.zh-Hans: 余标架将这一结构组织为局部方向。当面成为薄片，这些方向把模构造连接到洛伦兹几何。

cues.en: Soldering connects the frame to geometry. Applying the Lorentz generators in opposite orders leaves the rotation displayed by their commutator.
cues.fr: La soudure relie le repère à la géométrie. Appliquer les générateurs de Lorentz dans des ordres opposés laisse la rotation affichée par leur commutateur.
cues.pt-BR: A solda conecta o referencial à geometria. Aplicar os geradores de Lorentz em ordens opostas deixa a rotação exibida pelo comutador.
cues.zh-Hans: 焊接把标架连接到几何。以相反顺序应用洛伦兹生成元，留下其对易子所示的旋转。

cues.en: The plaquette follows transport around a small loop. Its mismatch makes curvature visible; the displayed curvature formula ties that change to the generator coefficients.
cues.fr: La plaquette suit le transport sur une petite boucle. Son écart rend visible la courbure ; la formule affichée relie ce changement aux coefficients des générateurs.
cues.pt-BR: A plaqueta acompanha o transporte num pequeno circuito. Seu desajuste torna visível a curvatura; a fórmula exibida liga essa mudança aos coeficientes dos geradores.
cues.zh-Hans: 小回路跟随输运绕行。回返的差异使曲率显现；所示曲率公式将这一变化与生成元系数联系起来。

cues.en: The sheet descends into the throat as the camera follows the static, spherical Schwarzschild geometry. The optical construction shapes the path through the scene.
cues.fr: La nappe descend dans la gorge tandis que la caméra suit la géométrie statique et sphérique de Schwarzschild. La construction optique façonne le parcours dans la scène.
cues.pt-BR: O lençol desce à garganta enquanto a câmera acompanha a geometria estática e esférica de Schwarzschild. A construção óptica dá forma ao percurso na cena.
cues.zh-Hans: 薄片向喉部下沉，镜头跟随史瓦西静态球对称几何。光学构造塑造场景中的路径。

cues.en: Beside it, the temporal and radial residuals compare the calculated geometry with the equations. Their displayed values let the viewer follow that check as the horizon comes into view.
cues.fr: À côté, les résidus temporel et radial comparent la géométrie calculée aux équations. Leurs valeurs affichées permettent de suivre cette vérification lorsque l’horizon apparaît.
cues.pt-BR: Ao lado, os resíduos temporal e radial comparam a geometria calculada com as equações. Seus valores exibidos permitem acompanhar essa verificação quando o horizonte aparece.
cues.zh-Hans: 旁边的时间和径向残差将计算几何与方程比较。视界显现时，观众可通过所示数值跟随这项检验。

cues.en: The tensor rotates with the spin weight shown by the program. Opposite helicities provide 2 transverse polarizations.
cues.fr: Le tenseur tourne avec le poids de spin indiqué par le programme. Les hélicités opposées fournissent 2 polarisations transverses.
cues.pt-BR: O tensor gira com o peso de spin mostrado pelo programa. Helicidades opostas fornecem 2 polarizações transversais.
cues.zh-Hans: 张量按程序显示的自旋权重旋转。相反螺旋度提供 2 个横向偏振。

cues.fr: Quand le repère tourne, l’hélice suit la phase angulaire du tenseur. Ses brins rendent visible la structure de polarisation, tandis que le résidu affiché vérifie la loi de transformation.
